description: This Java class defines the SearchErrorResponse, a response object for handling errors related to ThingSearchCommand in the Eclipse Ditto project. It wraps a DittoRuntimeException and provides methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: SearchErrorResponse
classes.description: An immutable response class representing an error in the ThingSearchCommand process, wrapping a DittoRuntimeException and providing JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and string representation methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SearchErrorResponse instance with the specified DittoRuntimeException and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a SearchErrorResponse from a JSON string or JsonObject, using provided headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the exception's JSON payload to a JsonObjectBuilder, respecting schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new SearchErrorResponse with the specified headers.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code for the object, including the wrapped exception.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, considering the wrapped exception and superclass.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method for equality checks, confirming the other object is an instance of SearchErrorResponse.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including class name, superclass info, and wrapped exception.
